restaurantName: The River Restaurant by Gordon Ramsay
address: Savoy Hotel, Strand, London, WC2R 0EU, United Kingdom
bio: One of several Gordon Ramsay operations inside The Savoy, this elegant restaurant is located at the back of the iconic hotel, accessed by a walk through the stunning Thames Foyer – and the dining room's best seats include a view of Victoria Embankment Gardens and the river itself. The cooking also has water on its mind, offering a bounty of top-quality seafood in a multitude of ways: embrace the opulent with caviar and oysters while sitting at the central Raw Bar; keep things traditional with sole meunière; or warm the soul with smoked haddock and mussel chowder....
pageTitle: The River Restaurant by Gordon Ramsay
